changelog.migration_note: No migration required; first supported contract version.
changelog.summary: Initial Period v1 backend contract skeleton: domain models, Atlas trackers, settings, calendar feed, privacy manifest, local bundle validation, and contract snapshots.

compatibility_policy: Additive changes may extend schemas, endpoints, examples, or enum-adjacent metadata without removing fields. Breaking changes remove or rename fields, change value semantics, or make previously valid payloads invalid. Flutter should accept additive versions with regeneration/tests and require an explicit migration for breaking versions.
